items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The band – Mtume [James Forman] brought them in.

ctx.x: Which is an interesting record. Apparently on that record he brought in Dominique Gaumont and he brought in Azar Lawrence.
He didn’t bring them in. The band – Mtume [James Forman] brought them in.
What was the deal behind that?
